svg.title: K14 · The bot has an ID card, but the door stays shut: the setup
svg.desc: The cast of scenario 14: Pod bot (leaderboard bot, counts player Pods); API server (the cluster's, front door); Deployment players (2 player Pods). Also: ServiceAccount (leaderboard-bot, the bot's ID card). Your mission: The bot has a valid ID card. Why is it not allowed?
